SELECT agent_runs.id, agent_runs.tenant_id, agent_runs.agent_name, agent_runs.status, agent_runs.input_data, agent_runs.output_data, agent_runs.iteration_count, agent_runs.model, agent_runs.strategy, agent_runs.parent_run_id, agent_runs.delegation_level, agent_runs.retry_of_run_id, agent_runs.total_input_tokens, agent_runs.total_output_tokens, agent_runs.total_cost_usd, agent_runs.total_cache_read_tokens, agent_runs.total_cache_creation_tokens, agent_runs.total_reasoning_tokens, agent_runs.meta, agent_runs.pause_data, agent_runs.pii_mapping, agent_runs.error, agent_runs.last_progress_at, agent_runs.failure_reason, agent_runs.idempotency_key, agent_runs.idempotency_fingerprint, agent_runs.cancel_requested, agent_runs.pause_requested, agent_runs.claim_epoch, agent_runs.storage_format, agent_runs.reclaim_attempts, agent_runs.reclaim_limit, agent_runs.lease_expired_at, agent_runs.last_reclaimed_at, agent_runs.loop_state, agent_runs.trace_link, agent_runs.created_at, agent_runs.updated_at, agent_runs.status_changed_at FROM agent_runs WHERE agent_runs.id = ?
SELECT agent_runs.loop_state FROM agent_runs WHERE agent_runs.id = ?
SELECT JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_runs.meta, ?)) AS anon_1 FROM agent_runs WHERE agent_runs.id = ?

SELECT react_traces.id, react_traces.agent_run_id, react_traces.role, react_traces.content, react_traces.trace_kind, react_traces.content_digest, react_traces.order_index, react_traces.meta, react_traces.created_at, react_traces.updated_at FROM react_traces WHERE react_traces.agent_run_id = ? AND react_traces.trace_kind IN (?, ?) AND react_traces.order_index > ? ORDER BY react_traces.order_index LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

INSERT INTO agent_runs (id, tenant_id, agent_name, status, input_data, iteration_count, model, strategy, parent_run_id, delegation_level, retry_of_run_id, total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, total_cost_usd, total_cache_read_tokens, total_cache_creation_tokens, total_reasoning_tokens, meta, pii_mapping, error, last_progress_at, failure_reason, idempotency_key, idempotency_fingerprint, cancel_requested, pause_requested, claim_epoch, storage_format, reclaim_attempts, reclaim_limit, lease_expired_at, last_reclaimed_at, loop_state, trace_link, created_at, updated_at, status_changed_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

INSERT INTO react_traces (id, agent_run_id, role, content, trace_kind, content_digest, order_index, meta, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

INSERT INTO react_traces (id, agent_run_id, role, content, trace_kind, content_digest, order_index, meta, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
UPDATE agent_runs SET updated_at=?, last_progress_at=CASE WHEN (agent_runs.storage_format = ?) THEN ? ELSE agent_runs.last_progress_at END WHERE agent_runs.id = ? AND agent_runs.claim_epoch = ?

INSERT INTO run_events (id, agent_run_id, event_type, sequence_index, iteration_index, correlation_id, data, created_at, content_digest) SELECT ? AS anon_1, ? AS anon_2, ? AS anon_3, (SELECT coalesce(max(run_events.sequence_index), ?) + ? AS anon_5 FROM run_events WHERE run_events.agent_run_id = ?) AS anon_4, ? AS anon_6, ? AS anon_7, ? AS anon_8, ? AS anon_9, ? AS anon_10 ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING sequence_index
